counters.name: Sensor Array
counters.tradeoff: Lifts the fog: raw metrics for CPU, threads, pools and disk. Costs upkeep every wave.

counters.name: Command Display
counters.tradeoff: Dashboards turn metrics into answers: latency, error rate, forecasts, the traffic heatmap.

counters.name: Create index
counters.tradeoff: Fixes the root cause. Needs pg_stat_statements to find the query.

options.name: CREATE INDEX
options.tradeoff: Fast to build, but blocks writes on the table while it runs.

options.name: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
options.tradeoff: No write lock, but slower and adds database I/O while it builds.

actions.name: Free disk space
actions.detail: Removes logs by hand. How you remove them matters.

options.name: truncate -s 0 app.log
options.detail: Empties the active log in place: the space is free at once, the log history is gone.

options.name: Delete old .gz archives
options.detail: Safe: rotated archives nobody reads. Frees a little, once.
